text:
Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was India's ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952, succeeding Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit, who held the post from 1947 to 1949. The team note is wrong that Radhakrishnan was India's first ambassador to Moscow; Pandit held that position first, and the note's own description fits Radhakrishnan's later career only. I answered from memory without opening the cited sources, so the Wilson Center link is still unverified.
CONFIDENCE: 90
